desc: Derive/verify the gap-reversal invariant: operation on 4 consecutive pieces reverses the three gaps (a,b,c)→(c,b,a); confirmed against sample 1 (gaps 4,2,3 → 3,2,4 gives sum 21).
Verify parity-class permutability: 3-reversals preserve index parity and generate full symmetric group within each parity class (standard result; consistent with both samples).

Establish sum formula: answer = N*x_1 + Σ g_k*(N-k); minimize each parity class via rearrangement inequality (largest gap paired with largest k / smallest weight). Verified: sample 1 → 21, sample 2 → 41.

Implement: read N, X; compute gaps; split by index parity (1-indexed); sort each class ascending; pair with weights descending; answer = N*X[0] + Σ weight*gap; print. O(N log N), 64-bit safe (Python ints).

Final review of code for I/O format and correctness: buffered stdin parsing, single-integer stdout, algebra of gap reversal checked, rearrangement pairing verified, edge cases (N=4, large coordinates) confirmed safe.
